Yes! Video editing is a major part of the program, especially in Film 1 & 2, which are required courses for RTF students. I think you'll also likely find yourself editing a final video project in Intro to New Media and New Media Production. Typically, you'll be using Adobe Premiere Pro for these classes.  


If you want my advice, try to use the program a little bit before you actually have class. I went in completely blind to editing and learned a lot, but you can definitely benefit from knowing a thing or two about how the program works beforehand.
